# Prompts queued for a pane (PromptQueue) go one at a time, each once the
# pane's agent is at rest: a stand-in agent (tests/fixtures/fake-agent-queue.c,
# built as "claude" by tests/run.sh)
# says idle, working and done (OSC 7501). While it waits for you (blocked)
# nothing goes. The pane and its tab's row say how many wait.
type:@DIR@/claude
key:enter
wait:1.0
queue-prompt:first
queue-prompt:ask
queue-prompt:third
# The first goes at once (the agent is at rest); the others wait.
expect-queue:2
expect-queue:tag=2 queued
expect-tab:2: 2 queued
wait:1.0
expect-not:GOT[ask]
wait:2.0
expect:GOT[first]
expect-queue:1
# Waiting for your answer: the last one stays queued.
wait:2.0
expect-queue:1
expect-not:GOT[third]
wait:3.5
expect:GOT[ask]
wait:2.5
expect:GOT[third]
expect-queue:0
expect-queue:untagged
expect-tab-not:queued
